name: NyxBot Voice
description: Realtime voice for a specific personal Bot. The owner explicitly creates a separate voice connection for each Bot in Agent details, then grants that UserService to an Agent Key. A generic catalog connection authorizes no Bot. Each Bot retains its existing grants, confirmations, private conversation history and billing. Keys with all-services access include published connections under the existing policy.
auth_notes: Internal NyxID capability: the ordinary proxy dispatches in this deployment without outbound HTTP or Bearer forwarding. Requires an ordinary Agent Key with proxy scope and a grant to the exact owner-published Bot Voice UserService. The service binding selects the Bot. Generic catalog connections authorize no Bot; no provider credential is distributed.
known_limitations: Personal owned Bots only. Publish through Agent details; direct catalog connection does not bind a Bot. Operation-scoped Keys cannot open WebSockets under existing B1 policy. Voice forwarding uses the exact Agent Key service grant and existing Bot realtime confirmations and billing; it adds no service-operation approval gate. Devices share the Bot home thread and existing per-person live-call slot. All API and background workers must be upgraded and old workers drained before enabling assistant:voice-agent-key. Announcement support is exposed per provider option; only personal OpenAI Live currently supports it.
